title: Puppet Styling Preset (v2)
description: User-authored styling configuration file. v2 adds the optional 'outline' object for persistent toon-outline state. v1 presets remain loadable.

materials.description: Map of body-part name (without pup. prefix) to material preset name

style.description: Accessory catalog id, e.g. sneakers, boots, cap, beanie

attach_bone.description: Bone to parent the accessory to; must be valid for the style

background.description: Background scenario catalog id or null for none

enabled.description: Apply inverted-hull toon outlines to pup.* and acc.* objects

thickness.description: Outline thickness in absolute Blender units; null derives limb_thickness × 0.15

color.description: #rrggbb hex or material catalog name; null uses near-black default

outline.description: Toon outline state; ignored when fill_mode is 'outline' (wireframe wins)
